sections.title: Exam Technique
sections.summary: How AAT assessments work and how to study for them.

blocks.text: Unit assessments are usually timed computer-based exams with objective and task-style items. Synoptic assessments may combine skills across units. Always confirm current unit codes, duration and booking rules on the official AAT website before sitting an assessment.

items: Practise calculations with a clear workings habit: many computer-based assessments reward accuracy under time pressure.
Drill weak units daily rather than only re-reading notes.
Learn ethics and business environment topics early: they appear across levels.
Use timed mocks to build pacing for longer Level 3 and 4 assessments.
Confirm official syllabus updates: qualification structures can change by intake year.
